notes.title: Version 0.4.0
notes.content:
Added 16 new languages: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

Happy New Year, everyone!

notes.title: Version 0.3.2
notes.content:
Icons, including control prompts. Various improvements and fixes.

1. Added icons of two types.
a) Symbolizing a related action for better intuitive perception.
b) Control prompts (for mouse, keyboard, and Xbox/PlayStation 4 controllers). You can choose between options for gamepads in the settings menu.

2. Last update greatly improved the tutorials, but quietly broke the keyboard and gamepad control of them. Fixed.

3. In addition, you can now hold buttons in tutorials to quickly change values.

4. Performed minor visual changes.

5. Fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.2.1
notes.content:
In this version:

1) Added translations into languages:
[list]
[*] Deutsch (German);
[*] Español (Spanish);
[*] Français (French);
[*] 日本語 (Japanese).
[/list]

2) Added a light frame around the active tile. Not only does it look nice, but it also helps when playing with a gamepad/keyboard.

3) Fixed many bugs related to the new interface, gamepad/keyboard support, and their interaction.

We invite you to our [url=https://discord.gg/2KFfNY6JRC]server on Discord[/url]! There you can discuss the game with other players, offer ideas for improving the game, and also report bugs or translation errors.

notes.title: Version 0.1.4 + development news
notes.content:
[h2]In this update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 10 new levels in the new pack.
[*] The cursor mode has been changed from software to hardware: the size has been reduced and the input delay has been reduced. Now the cursor will be more responsive and not so bulky.
[*] Improved Steam Cloud support. Previously, different accounts on the same computer shared progress and settings. Now each account will have its own saved data.
[/list]

[h2]About current development.[/h2]
For the last three weeks, we have been working on porting the game interface to the new system (Unity UI Toolkit). This process is quite laborious and time-consuming. However, a transition is necessary as the new approach is much better scalable and supported. In addition, the interface on the new system looks much nicer.

At the moment, most of the basic components and the interface of the level editor have been transferred. Further in the plans is the interface of the game itself, but not just a transfer, but a complete rework, taking into account the wishes of beta testers.

notes.title: Version 0.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 12 new levels with hexagons. Some are quite challenging.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for level clearing (key R), undo (key Z) and redo (key X) operations, and menu interaction (key Esc).
[*] Performed some internal improvements (aka refactoring).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Sounds! Now you will have audio feedback while playing! There are sounds for: any line draw/break event; activation and deactivation of one target; activation and deactivation of multiple targets.
[*] You can also adjust the volume of these sounds, both in the main menu and the game menu.
[*] Language and volume settings are now saved. You don't have to set them up every time you start the game.
[*] According to beta-testers, it was inconvenient to clear the level by first entering the menu, and then clicking the "Restart this level" button. Now the "Clear" button has been added direcctly to the game, in the bottom left corner.
[*] Also added "Undo" and "Redo" buttons in the bottom right corner. So, if you accidentally break some line that you have been thinking about for a long time, you can easily restore it.
[*] Some player(-s?) found an unforeseen solution for one of the final levels in the "Introduction" pack. Moved it into the "Broken Solutions" pack, level #5, so anyone can try to find this solution!
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
